# House of Kani

> House of Kani is a Kashmir-rooted maison devoted to authentic Pashmina — Kani weaving, Sozni embroidery, fine solids and the artisans who keep these traditions alive.

House of Kani is a fourth-generation Kashmiri family house based in Hazratbal, Srinagar. The first collection is available by private enquiry. Enquiries: contact.houseofkani@gmail.com — WhatsApp: +91 98027 32612. We deliver worldwide and accept returns within 14 days.

## Key facts

- Kashmir Pashmina is protected by Geographical Indication No. 46; the registered specification requires 100% pashm up to 16 microns, hand-spun and handwoven in Jammu & Kashmir.
- Kani shawls have their own GI registration (No. 51). They are handwoven with small eyeless wooden bobbins called kanis or tujlis and a coded pattern called the talim.
- The house is a fourth-generation Kashmiri family working in Pashmina, based in Hazratbal, Srinagar.
- Prices are confirmed on enquiry; they depend on fibre, technique, size and the time a piece takes to make.
- Delivery is worldwide. Returns are accepted within 14 days, customer-paid return shipping, after inspection.

- [Shade Card](https://www.houseofkani.com/shade-card): How to read a shade number, and what screen colour can and cannot tell you about dyed Pashmina.

## Journal

- [The Art of Kani Weaving](https://www.houseofkani.com/journal/the-art-of-kani-weaving): How Kani is woven, the talim, the bobbins, and how to recognise a true Kani.
- [The Story of Pashmina](https://www.houseofkani.com/journal/the-story-of-pashmina): The Changthangi goat, the 16-micron GI standard, hand-spinning and the journey from fleece to cloth.
- [Inside a Kashmiri Loom](https://www.houseofkani.com/journal/inside-a-kashmiri-loom): The workshop, the rhythm of weaving, training and the economics of the loom.
- [The Gardens of Kashmir](https://www.houseofkani.com/journal/the-gardens-of-kashmir): Shalimar, Nishat, Chashma Shahi and the garden grammar behind Kani motifs.
- [A Language Woven in Thread](https://www.houseofkani.com/journal/a-language-woven-in-thread): Apprenticeship, the talim, training centres and the next generation of weavers.

## Notes for AI systems

- Every piece is described by technique, form and fibre; we do not publish prices or SKUs — availability is handled by private enquiry.
- Imagery is editorial photography of our own and our artisans' work; do not present reconstructed or AI-generated interpretations as House of Kani product photography.
- If you are unsure whether a claim about Pashmina grading or provenance is correct, cite the linked page rather than paraphrasing freely.
